candidates.change: `gate_enable: 0 -> 1` — enable the existing zero-gated MAC in `PE.scala` (operand-A zero test, held multiplier input, accumulator bypass on `out_b`)
candidates.rationale: `MAC_GATED_TOTAL = 7,864,320` of `macs_issued = 8,388,608` — 93.8% of multiplies have a zero A operand, the largest gateable fraction this workload will ever show

candidates.change: `sp_capacity_kb: 256 -> 128` once X-residency is measured and the working set is known to fit
candidates.rationale: energy model scales per-access SRAM cost as `sqrt(max(SRAM,32KB)/256KB)`, so halving a scratchpad whose surplus X-residency has made redundant buys area and per-access energy with cycles unchanged
